# HELP busbar_bucket_budget_remaining_cents Budget-group cap minus derived spend for the current window
# HELP busbar_bucket_spend_cents Derived spend (abstract minor units) per budget-group bucket for its current window, recomputed from the token ledger x the current rate card at scrape time
# HELP busbar_bucket_tokens Per-(bucket, model, tier) tokens in the bucket's current budget window (key and budget-group buckets; derived from the token ledger at scrape time)
# HELP busbar_key_spend_cents Per-virtual-key accumulated spend in cents for the current budget window (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_key_tokens_total Per-virtual-key accumulated tokens consumed in the current budget window (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_lane_available Per-(pool,lane) availability from the shared classify taxonomy: 1 = would admit, 0 = unavailable for any reason (breaker/capacity/dead/budget) (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_lane_available_permits Per-(pool,lane) available concurrency permits for a BOUNDED lane (scrape-time; unbounded lanes emit no sample)
# HELP busbar_lane_inflight Per-(pool,lane) in-flight requests (held concurrency permits) (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_lane_recovery_hint_ms Per-(pool,lane) honest lower bound (ms) on when an unavailable lane could next serve; 0 when available or no self-recovery basis (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_lane_state Per-(pool,lane) circuit-breaker health: 0=healthy, 1=half-open, 2=tripped (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_pool_queued Per-pool requests currently parked in the on_exhausted queue bounded wait (scrape-time)
# HELP busbar_request_duration_seconds End-to-end request duration in seconds
# HELP busbar_requests_total Total ingress requests, by ingress protocol, pool, and outcome
# HELP busbar_upstream_attempts_total Upstream call attempts, by pool and lane
# TYPE busbar_billing_truncated_total counter
# TYPE busbar_bucket_budget_remaining_cents gauge
# TYPE busbar_bucket_spend_cents gauge
# TYPE busbar_bucket_tokens gauge
# TYPE busbar_key_spend_cents gauge
# TYPE busbar_key_tokens_total gauge
# TYPE busbar_lane_available gauge
# TYPE busbar_lane_available_permits gauge
# TYPE busbar_lane_inflight gauge
# TYPE busbar_lane_recovery_hint_ms gauge
# TYPE busbar_lane_state gauge
# TYPE busbar_pool_queued gauge
# TYPE busbar_request_duration_seconds summary
# TYPE busbar_requests_total counter
# TYPE busbar_upstream_attempts_total counter
